title: A browser history
description:
Model a browser's back and forward buttons with two stacks.

```
visit a.com, visit b.com, visit c.com
back -> b.com
back -> a.com
forward -> b.com
visit d.com (forward history cleared)
forward -> nothing
```
hints: `back()`: if the back stack is empty, return `null`; otherwise push `current` onto `forward` and pop the new current from `back` (lesson 5.04).
`visit` pushes the old current (if any) onto `back` and calls `forward.clear()`.
requirements: `visit(url)`, `back()`, `forward()` return the current page, or `null` when there is nowhere to go.
Visiting a page clears the forward stack.
stretch: Limit the back history to 50 pages, dropping the oldest with `removeLast`.
